FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT)(COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(JOHOR CAUSEWAY-JOHOR BAHRU-TAMPOI HIGHWAY)(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Johor Causeway-Johor Bahru-Tampoi Highway)

(Amendment) Order 2020.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 February 2020.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Johor Causeway-Johor Bahru-Tampoi Highway) Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 14/1989],

which is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)

by substituting for the words "12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038"

the words "1 February 2020 to 31 December 2058".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL FOR THE PERIOD FROM 1 FEBRUARY 2020 UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2058

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicle with two axles and three or four 2.37

wheels (excluding taxi and bus)

2. Vehicle with two axles and five or six 4.50

wheels (excluding bus)

3 Vehicle with three axles or more 6.10

(excluding bus)

4. Taxi 1.14

5. Bus 1.88

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 31 January 2020

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/1 Jilid 21; PN(PU2)426/LXVIII]

 BARU BIAN

 Minister of Works
